primary_observable: Derivative of mean core projection on the fixed internally projected closure vector with respect to its conjugate force
closure_force_rule: Use the maximum zero-force closure SD across fixed, rigid and flexible pilots: F0*sigma_max/(RT)=0.25. Lock one common F0 before force comparison.
normalization: Report absolute closure susceptibility first. Estimate the 801-dimensional mean susceptibility only with an independently converged covariance or isotropic force-probe estimator; do not normalize by one unrelated CV.
gauge: The same six reference-core collective translation/rotation constraints or a validated finite-restraint limit in every model, imposed during sampling, not just post-hoc alignment
replicate_unit: independent initialization and equilibration; frames are not independent replicates

candidate_followup.rule: Fix any atomistic perturbation and its controls after inspecting atomistic interactions but before computing its response effect. Do not equate a spring multiplier to an amino-acid substitution.

excluded_evidence: biased external trajectories as independent equilibrium samples
qm: only if a metal parameterization gate cannot be satisfied with an applicable published parameter set; no unvalidated legacy parameters

technical_model.zinc_parameter_model: ZAFF center 1, CY1/S1 and ZN1/ZN, complete bonded-site charges and parameters
technical_model.technical_salt_policy: Neutralization only for integration feasibility; physiological salt must be fixed before scientific response sampling.
technical_model.preparation_scope: One repaired loop/sidechain model for technical feasibility only; alternative models are required before representation-robust claims.
